description: Oil Capacity is a dataset listed in Artificial Intelligence Global Company - ODS open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by US Energy Information Administration. This open data contains information about World oil capacity from 1980. Data from US Energy Information Administration. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org and it’s APIs to stay in sync and advance energy economics research. Coverage: Gulf Cooperation Council states. The portal files it under Oil & gas. Its keywords are Oil. The portal shows 64,813 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-aigc-portal.
